engineeringQa.semantics: Native crash injection is a build-only capability allowed exclusively for the explicit internal APP_ENV allowlist. Missing, unknown, publicdev, preview, and production environments fail closed.

buildDefaults.inheritedByAppEnvironments: Every canonical EAS build profile inherits the validated native renderer gates from the shared base profile.

conditionalRuntimeGates.HAPPIER_TERMINAL_NATIVE_IOS_ACCESSIBILIT: Physical-iPhone VoiceOver and hardware-key navigation remain unproven; iOS builds stay accessibility fallback-required, so Auto keeps xterm WebView only while a screen reader is active.

evidenceBasis.iosPackageAndCrashFallback: Accepted signed iOS run term-run-c21798a9-37be-4b68-b282-d0f604c9885f (two-build package proof, exact install/hash binding, crash-to-WebView replay continuity).
evidenceBasis.androidDependencyClosureGradleAbiCrash: Accepted signed Android run term-run-174fe266-dab7-44d7-aeef-eb45303ff572 packaging gates (dependency closure, Gradle build, ABI smoke, crash-fallback build capability).
evidenceBasis.androidAccessibilityNative: Accepted signed Android run term-run-174fe266-dab7-44d7-aeef-eb45303ff572 proves real TalkBack navigation with the localized output-driven summary and focus/copy/select-all/open-link actions, so canonical builds may truthfully report accessibility native.

buildDefaults.boundary: Validated package, dependency, ABI, crash-fallback, and Android accessibility gates are shared build defaults. iOS physical VoiceOver/hardware-key evidence remains conditional: it controls only screen-reader selection and never blocks ordinary native Ghostty use.

deviceEvidence.semantics: Schema v2 accepts only run-scoped semantic reports bound to an authority-signed capture inventory and a signed build identity extracted from the retained IPA/APK, plus the loaded-app nonce/build evidence id, canonical source/dependency closure, and gate-specific technical packaging attestations. The repository registers only QA public keys; private capture keys remain outside source with restricted permissions.

linkCompatibility.reason: Ghostty Wuffs 0.4 and React Native Skia Wuffs 0.3 export overlapping unversioned symbols; isolate Ghostty's private copy before the final app link.

directGhosttyBuild.requiredAction: Open and complete a separate pinned direct-source build packet before using this path.

fallbackUpstream.name: ghostty
fallbackUpstream.useWhen: Candidate upstream for a separate future direct-source-build packet if libghostty-spm becomes stale, divergent, unavailable, or release-blocking

notes: Selected iOS v1 substrate for the GhosttyKit XCFramework artifact and libghostty C module bridge.
GhosttyTerminal Swift sources are an API/lifecycle reference unless Happier explicitly vendors/builds that source target later.
Must be pinned by exact revision/version and checksum before production bundling.
Patch/source provenance, license/NOTICE, size, ABI smoke, App Store/export, and update/rollback procedure are release gates.
Vendors GhosttyKit.xcframework directly in an iOS Xcode project.
Wraps the Ghostty C surface API from Swift for runtime/app/surface lifecycle, byte feed, write callback, resize, draw, selection, text extraction, and clipboard.
Use as lifecycle/API reference only; do not make Remodex a production binary supply-chain dependency.

forbiddenModules.name: app
forbiddenModules.reason: The full Termux app is GPL-3.0-only and is out of scope for the native renderer package.

forbiddenModules.name: termux-shared
forbiddenModules.reason: TERM-6 only approves terminal-view and terminal-emulator until dependency closure review says otherwise.

remoteSessionAdapter.reason: Termux TerminalSession/TerminalView are process-backed; Happier adapts TerminalEmulator and TerminalRenderer to the remote daemon byte stream without spawning a local Android shell.

complianceBoundary.engineeringPolicyVerification: The extractor and Gradle checks verify the exact pinned revision, terminal-only Apache-2.0 module closure, copied upstream license and NOTICE assets, and forbidden GPL-module absence.
complianceBoundary.releaseSemantics: Validated source and attribution compliance is enforced mechanically; there is no separate legal-approval build flag or repository approval record.
